g.text: Workflow 2: technician investigates -> SLA monitored -> incident resolved -> user notified
opens the queue (SLA chips count down)
respond(now): response target met or missed
"SLA approaching" to assignee and Team Lead (in-app, Telegram)
"SLA violated" to assignee, Team Lead and admins
resume(now): paused time excluded from the deadline
top 3 similar resolved incidents (+ summary citing only them)
"Your incident is resolved: please verify" (in-app, email)
the technician sees it back in the queue (live push)
A RESOLVED incident nobody verifies is closed by the
monitor after 72 h (BR-03). NEW -> CLOSED, or any other
